notes: Removes cross-boot Twin Button DFU recovery from Smoke Tester: no pending update is read from NVS at startup, so normal boot and repeating error indication are no longer seized by a stale update. Twin discovery beside a phone link remains silent until an outdated Twin is confirmed. Once started, recovery exists only in RAM for the current powered session. If Twin finishes image activation but its bootloader does not reboot, Smoke waits for flash activation, sends the Nordic system-reset command over the existing link, reconnects to the Twin application, verifies version 1.1.28, and then ends the update indication. Twin Button 1.1.28 also bounds the post-DFU cue to 60 seconds and smoothly returns to blue BLE search if session configuration is missed. Includes the tiras5 dual-bank bootloader.
